display_name: Cyberpunk 2077 built-in benchmark (assisted: you start it from the menu)
warning: Cyberpunk 2077 starts through Steam. When its main menu shows, start the built-in benchmark yourself (Settings, then Run Benchmark); the app waits up to 15 minutes for the result file and then closes the game. Do not use the computer otherwise meanwhile.
notes: Verified on 2026-10-18 with the owner present (session 4, game version 2.31, RTX 5090 Laptop, 2560x1440): the game is started directly (bin/x64/Cyberpunk2077.exe with the arguments, so Steam asks nothing), summary.json was written to Documents\CD Projekt Red\Cyberpunk 2077 enchmarkResults enchmark_<date>\, Data.averageFps / minFps / maxFps were read (76.43 / 65.57 / 104.37 FPS) and the app closed the game. -skipStartScreen did not skip the 'press to continue' screen in 2.31: the user presses a key there, then starts the benchmark from the menu. No keys are sent. If the file or its keys differ, the run is 'invalid' (never a 0). Frame times by PresentMon are a separate capture (Frame capture tab).
